content.short: OpenSea Subgraph utilizes the Graph Protocol to extract raw blockchain data and transform it into useful metrics for analytics.
content.description: Developed by Messari, OpenSea Subgraph is a decentralized and verifiable data source for tracking and querying Seaport marketplace protocol events on the Ethereum blockchain. OpenSea Subgraph utilizes the Graph Protocol to extract raw blockchain data and transform it into useful metrics for analytics. Developers can retrieve data on orders, assets, and transactions that are executed on the Seaport marketplace via a unified GraphQL API endpoint.
